meta.name: astropy
meta.description: Core Python library for astronomy and astrophysics workflows that need Astropy APIs, including units/quantities, coordinates, FITS I/O, tables, time systems, WCS, and cosmology. Use when implementing or debugging astronomical data analysis code with Astropy.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 处理天文数据与物理量计算
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用Python做天文数据处理或模拟。
copy.tagline_en: Process astronomical data and physical quantities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently work with astronomical data or simulations in Python.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你用 Python 处理天文数据：转换天体坐标、换算物理单位、读写 FITS 文件、计算宇宙学距离、处理时间、操作表格等。
howto.when: 当你需要分析天文数据，比如处理星表、FITS 图像，或进行坐标、单位、时间、宇宙学计算时触发。

say.text: 用 Astropy 读取 FITS 文件 image.fits 并计算图像均值。
say.note: Claude 会生成 FITS 读取和分析代码。

say.text: 用 Planck18 宇宙学模型计算 z=1.5 的光度距离。
say.note: Claude 会生成宇宙学计算代码。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you process astronomical data in Python: transform celestial coordinates, convert physical units, read/write FITS files, compute cosmological distances, handle time, and manipulate tables.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to analyze astronomical data, such as processing catalogs, FITS images, or performing coordinate, unit, time, or cosmology calculations.

say_en.text: Use Astropy to transform ICRS coordinates (10.5°, 41.2°) to Galactic.
say_en.note: Claude will generate coordinate transformation code.

say_en.text: Read FITS file image.fits with Astropy and compute the mean of the image.
say_en.note: Claude will generate FITS reading and analysis code.

say_en.text: Compute luminosity distance at z=1.5 using Planck18 cosmology.
say_en.note: Claude will generate cosmology calculation code.
